title: Pop-Up Star Wars & Superhero Con: Free Springfield, Missouri Event
seo_title: Pop-Up Star Wars & Superhero Con in Springfield, MO
description: This is a Star Wars and superhero pop-up convention with free photo ops with Santa Claus and the Grinch, free 9"x12" prints for sharing or tagging on social media, a Saturday ugly Christmas sweater contest, and a Sunday cosplay contest where costumes are optional. Admission is free, optional VIP tickets are $15, and it is for all ages. It runs Friday, December 11, 2026 at 5:00 PM through Sunday, December 13 at 6:00 PM at University Plaza Hotel & Convention Center, 333 S John Q Hammons Pkwy in Springfield, Missouri; free reservations are not required except for VIP tickets, and hotel parking is $10 per day while free parking is available downtown.
